_comment: P12 Ayarlar / Tweaks form. tab > section > setting. A toggle has two states; 'default' is what Windows does on its own (nothing is written) and 'writes' / 'services' belong to the other state. A dropdown / radio lists 'options'; the one without writes or services is the Windows default. apply=firstLogon: also re-applied after setup (D-026). control 'text': no options — the typed string goes to every key / name in 'writes'; control 'file': the picked JPEG is copied to 'copy' in the image and the 'writes' (which point Windows at it) go with it; for both an empty value is the Windows default. 'files' ({path, content}: a text file written into the image, under Users\Default or ProgramData) belong to an option like its writes. recommended: what 'Önerilenleri uygula' picks (toggle: true = the non-default state; dropdown / radio: an option id). Two settings write the same value only on purpose (a dropdown and a text box for one value: pagefile, Settings pages).
